name: Counting Prototype Christmas Version - Speed OK
author: juanedmendo
description: I made a complete change to my counting prototype game turning it into a Christmas adventure. Christmas is near and Santa's workshop is stopped, elfs are trying to repair the catapult to shoot power balls inside the workshop's power container. It is time for you to help them collect the slippery power balls spawning from Santa's magical bag and then shoot them with your Christmas Tank into the power container until it stores enough balls to power up Santa's Workshop. (Controls inside game). Demo video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OIXLd237h20
